response:
I hear how incredibly heavy and overwhelming things feel right now. It is completely understandable to feel exhausted when it seems like nothing is going right and you are carrying this burden alone. Please know that you are not alone in feeling this way, even if it seems like everyone else has it figured out. 

Because you mentioned wondering if things would be better if you weren't around, your safety is the most important thing right now. Please connect with free, confidential help by calling or texting 988 (the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline in the US and Canada) or texting HOME to 741741 to reach the Crisis Text Line. If you are outside North America, please contact your local emergency services or a crisis hotline immediately. There are people who want to listen and help you through this pain, so please reach out to them today. You do not have to go through this by yourself.
